_documentation: current_dev_agent_model_families lists the model families used as RUNTIME PRODUCERS (Surface Mapper, Skeptic, etc.) in cbm runs, not the build-agent that authored this repository's code. ADR-005 requires that pass-claim checkpoints be reviewed by a model from a DIFFERENT family than the runtime producers. If pass-claim scope is ever extended to gate code-change PRs reviewed by the same family that wrote them, add the build-agent family (e.g. 'claude', 'anthropic') here and record the decision in BUILD-LOG.md.
